message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.43, "reasons": ["Artifact provides only raw metric values with central/uncertainty columns but does not include the required 0–100 suitability normalization for each metric.", "No per-ion 0–100 scores or final weighted overall suitability score are computed or presented.", "No defensible weighting rationale or final recommendation is documented, nor is a 1-page analysis summary included.", "Column naming uses sodium_central/sodium_uncertainty and lithium_central/lithium_uncertainty instead of the requested sodium_ion and lithium_ion columns; alignment with the prescribed CSV structure is needed."], "guidance": "Produce a CSV with rows for each metric (energy_density_Wh_per_kg, cost_per_kWh_USD, cycle_life_cycles, calendar_life_years, round_trip_efficiency_pct, usable_DOD_pct, operating_temp_range_C, safety_score, recycling_score) and two main columns: sodium_ion and lithium_ion. If a metric has a range, include central and uncertainty sub-columns under each ion. Normalize each metric to a 0–100 suitability scale for residential home-battery use (specify whether higher is better for each metric), then compute a defensible weighting scheme (with rationale) and calculate the final weighted overall suitability score for both ions. Provide a short, 1-page analysis summarizing key numeric differences, the normalization method, the weights, and the final recommendation. Save both the CSV and the analysis text. Ensure column headers reflect sodium_ion and lithium_ion and include central/uncertainty where ranges exist."}
